title: Email
original_html:
Stay connected and collaborate effortlessly with York University's email service. All currently active employees of York University have a centrally supported yorku.ca email account as a requirement from HR to view pay stubs and other HR documents. With enterprise-level security features, you can rely on the email service to protect your messages and data. To access your email and Microsoft 365 account, you must maintain your active status as a staff or faculty member.

Submit a Service Request

Featured Services

  • Email
  • Email Lists (ListServ) 

Overview

All currently active employees of York University have a centrally supported yorku.ca email account as a requirement from HR to view pay stubs and other HR documents. Faculty and Staff use Microsoft Outlook, part of our M365 suite, which also includes calendars, task management and instant messaging.

**Please note: Faculty members may also be provided with a separate account for coursework or research.

When a non-academic staff member or contract academic employee of the University is no longer here, the email account will be disabled in accordance with established employment unit rules.

How do I access it?

To download Outlook, please follow the instructions here>>

Log in to Outlook>>
Faculty-Supported Email Accounts

Please contact your faculty helpdesk for assistance with Faculty-specific email accounts. 

  • Schulich Email - ends in @schulich.yorku.ca 
  • Osgoode Email - ends in @osgoode.yorku.ca 
  • Faculty of Education Email - ends in @edu.yorku.ca 

Click here for Email FAQs>>

Overview

ListServs are electronic mailing lists to which York community members can subscribe to exchange ideas and information and broadcast bulletins. As an option, archives of messages sent to a list can be stored and made accessible on the Web.

How do I access it?

Fill out and submit the LISTSERV Creation Request Form>>

You will need your Passport York username and password.

Quick Start for list owners>>
Quick Start for List subscribers>>
  • ListServs can be posted by "public" or "private" owners.
  • "Public" allows non-members to post information to ListServ, "private" is restricted to the members who have subscribed to a particular ListServ, and "owner" allows only owners of ListServ to post.
  • The maximum size for an incoming or outgoing message must not exceed 35MB. Some email attachments sent to ListServ may be removed or renamed for security reasons.
  • By default, ListServs are restricted to a maximum of 50 postings per day.

Click here for ListServ FAQs>>

Frequently Asked Questions

Microsoft Outlook FAQs

100 GB.

Click here for instructions on accessing your email archive.

Accessing the archived calendar is only supported on Classic Outlook for Windows. 

Currently, there is no support for accessing it through the Outlook Web App or Outlook for Mac. See the following for more information.

https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/troubleshoot/archive-mailboxes/cannot-see-calendar-folder

https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/office/use-your-online-archive-with-outlook-for-mac-f3ee42bd-f8b3-441f-b938-bf77aaee8a24

Instructions for accessing your archived calendar entries

  1. Confirm that you are using Classic Outlook.
  1. In the top-right corner of the Outlook window, you should see a switch labelled “Try the new Outlook”. If the switch is off, you're using Classic Outlook. Proceed to step 3.

If you see the New Outlook switch, you must revert to Classic Outlook. 

To revert, click on the Help menu, then select Go to classic Outlook. 

  1. Open Classic Outlook.
  • In the left navigation pane, click on the calendar icon.
  • Scroll down and click Calendar - Online Archive username@yorku.ca.

If you're looking to view emails older than two years in your mailbox, you'll need to enable Cached Exchange Mode in Outlook. This feature stores a copy of your mailbox on your computer, making it easier to access older emails without requiring a constant connection to the server.

Important: Cached Exchange Mode is only available for Outlook on Windows desktop clients. If you're using another platform, such as macOS or webmail, this option won't be available. For detailed instructions on enabling Cached Exchange Mode, visit Microsoft's guide>>

How to access it?

If you have already requested access to a shared mailbox, you can view it by following these steps:

  • Windows Desktop: Open and use a shared mailbox using the Windows Outlook desktop client, click here>>
  • Mac Desktop: Open and use a shared mailbox using the Mac Outlook desktop client, click here>>
  • Web: Open and use a shared mailbox using the Outlook web client, click here>>
  • Mobile: Open and use a shared mailbox using the Outlook mobile app, click here>>

Requesting Access

To add or remove users to or from a shared mailbox, the owner must submit a request to add/remove users to askit@yorku.ca. The request must include the Passport York username of each user being added/removed.

Accessing Archived Calendar Entries

Accessing the archived calendar is only supported on Classic Outlook for Windows. 

Currently, there is no support for accessing it through the Outlook Web App or Outlook for Mac. See the following for more information.

https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/troubleshoot/archive-mailboxes/cannot-see-calendar-folder

https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/office/use-your-online-archive-with-outlook-for-mac-f3ee42bd-f8b3-441f-b938-bf77aaee8a24

Instructions for accessing your archived calendar entries

  1. Confirm that you are using Classic Outlook.
  1. In the top-right corner of the Outlook window, you should see a switch labelled “Try the new Outlook”. If the switch is off, you're using Classic Outlook. Proceed to step 3.

If you see the New Outlook switch, you must revert to Classic Outlook. 

To revert, click on the Help menu, then select Go to classic Outlook. 

  1. Open Classic Outlook.
  • In the left navigation pane, click on the calendar icon.
  • Scroll down and click Calendar - Online Archive username@yorku.ca.

Viewing Email Older Than 2 Years

If you're looking to view emails older than two years in your mailbox, you'll need to enable Cached Exchange Mode in Outlook. This feature stores a copy of your mailbox on your computer, making it easier to access older emails without requiring a constant connection to the server.

Important: Cached Exchange Mode is only available for Outlook on Windows desktop clients. If you're using another platform, such as macOS or webmail, this option won't be available. For detailed instructions on enabling Cached Exchange Mode, visit Microsoft's guide>>
